description: Port calls at Finnish ports only (Portnet via Fintraffic Digitraffic): expected, arrived and departed ships with ETA/ETD/ATA/ATD, berth, vessel name/IMO/MMSI/flag/type, previous and next port. Filter by port UN/LOCODE (e.g. FIHEL), vessel, time window and status. Up to 15 port calls per call. Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller); CC BY 4.0; cached up to 15 min. Price 0.02 USD per call via x402.

from.description: ETA from: date, ISO time, now/today or relative (-1 day, -12 hours); default -1 day

ports.description: Comma-separated Finnish UN/LOCODEs, up to 10 (FIHEL, FIKTK, FIHMN, FITKU, FIRAU, FIOUL...); empty = all

status.description: Comma-separated subset of expected, arrived, departed

to.description: ETA to: date, ISO time, tomorrow or relative (+7 days); default +7 days

name: maritime_port_calls
